_comment: Repos with a production target. The deploy-watch routine polls each enabled repo's forge main; when the tip moved and its Forge CI status is success it runs the deploy-main Loom graph, which stages that exact OID and runs the repo's OWN deploy script with the same variables the retired launchd watchers gave it. `env` is copied into the deploy script's environment. `verify_command` runs after the deploy with DEPLOY_OID / DEPLOY_REPO set and must exit 0 (retried for up to 10 min). Disabled repos are listed so the retirement of their launchd agents is visible here, not only in launchd's override table.

repos.verify_command: curl -fsS --max-time 20 https://thelastdb.com/llms.txt | grep -q 'LastDB' && curl -fsSI --max-time 20 https://thelastdb.com/ | grep -qi '^HTTP/[0-9.]* 200'
repos.notes: thelastdb.com via vercel promote (token lastsecrets://lastgit-vercel-token). This repo's gate of record moved back to LastGit on 2026-09-27 (era-3 cutover, Tom's commit a7dd69b11f8); deploy-watch is Forgejo-only by construction and cannot serve it. The LastGit-native launchd watcher com.edgevector.lastgit-deploy-fold-db-website is the deployer of record again. Disabled here 2026-09-28 to match; see papercut-fold-db-website-two-prod-deployers-launchd-and-deploy-watch-20260923.
